title: Banff: Private Premium Tailored 3 Parks Tour–Moraine, Lake Louise
includes: Moraine Lake access via a 15-passenger van carrying up to 2 private groups as per Parks Canada rules
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
This is a private tour/activity. Only your group will participate
This experience requires good weather. If it’s canceled due to poor weather, you’ll be offered a different date or a full refund
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
From world-famous lakes like Moraine Lake & Lake Louise, enjoy a fully Customizable private 10–12 hrs premium luxury day tour through Banff, Yoho & Kootenay National Parks designed exclusively for you and your group. 

As a proudly Canadian-owned company, our local guides bring deep regional knowledge & personal insights taking you beyond the typical tourist routes to discover hidden gems & unforgettable viewpoints. Throughout the journey experience, 10+ breathtaking stops featuring turquoise alpine lakes, magical waterfalls and iconic landscapes of the Canadian Rockies.

• Enjoy a 100% Pure Banff experience while a local guide handles the driving, navigation & details.
• Customize your day by spending more time at your favourite spots or exploring the top highlights.
• Experience the Real Canada with optional activities like canoeing, hiking, scenic walks, and nature exploration.
• Travel comfortably in a premium vehicle with park fees, parking, and tour essentials included.
